description: This PHP source file defines the AccessTokenRepository class, which implements methods for managing OAuth2 access tokens, including persisting, revoking, and checking token status within the SuiteCRM project. It interacts with OAuth2 token entities and database-backed token storage.

classes.name: AccessTokenRepository
classes.description: Implements OAuth2 access token management functionalities such as persisting, revoking, and validating tokens for the SuiteCRM OAuth2 server.

methods.name: persistNewAccessToken
methods.description: Saves a new access token to the database, setting expiration, client, and user information.

methods.name: revokeAccessToken
methods.description: Marks a specified access token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isAccessTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks if a specified access token has been revoked or expired.

methods.name: getNewToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new access token entity for the given client, scopes, and user.
